projects.portal.noTeamDesc: You need to join a team before you can work on a project.
projects.portal.noProjectDescDetailed: When the hacking phase begins, a draft project will be created automatically for your team. You'll then be able to edit all the details, add a description, tech stack, demo links, screenshots, and more.
projects.portal.noProjectStep1: A draft project is created automatically when the competition enters the hacking stage
projects.portal.noProjectStep2: Your team can then edit the project, fill in details, upload assets, and prepare your submission
projects.portal.noProjectStep3: Make sure to submit before the deadline, you'll see a countdown timer once your project is ready to edit
projects.portal.noProjectNoTrack: No project — your team never selected a track
projects.portal.noProjectNoTrackDesc: Draft projects are created per track when the hacking stage begins, and your team had no track at that moment. Track selection is now closed, so this cannot be fixed from here — contact an organizer.
projects.portal.noProjectMissing: No project was created for your team
projects.portal.noProjectMissingDesc: The hacking stage has already started but your team has no draft project. Contact an organizer.
projects.portal.flaggedBanner: This project has been flagged for code reuse review.
projects.portal.deadlinePassed: Submission deadline has passed. Contact an organizer for an extension.
projects.portal.mediaHelp: Upload screenshots of your project. Images help judges understand your work. Accepted formats: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP.
projects.portal.feedbackReadmeHelp: Upload a README.md file with feedback about your team's experience using Open Mercato during the hackathon. This file is required for final submission.
projects.portal.originalityHelp: Transparency about pre-existing code is valued and does not penalize your team. Judges use this to assess what was built during the hackathon. Using existing code is allowed but must be declared.
projects.portal.incompleteFields: Complete all required fields to submit
projects.portal.ownerOnly: Only the team owner can submit the project.
projects.portal.submitConfirmMsg: Are you sure? This action cannot be undone. Your project will be locked for editing.
projects.portal.label: Your team project
projects.portal.title: My Project
projects.fields.title: Project Title
projects.fields.builtDuringDesc: What was built during the hackathon
projects.fields.checklist.title: Title
projects.notifications.autoPublishSkippe: The competition moved to Demo Day and your project was left out because it is incomplete: {reasons}.
projects.gallery.intro: The gallery is the public showcase of what teams ship on Open Mercato. Opt in and we will publish your project there after the hackathon.
projects.gallery.optIn: Publish this project to the Open Mercato Project Gallery
projects.gallery.optInHelp: Optional. Ticking this adds a few required fields below. Leave it unticked and nothing changes for your submission.
projects.gallery.summaryPlaceholder: One or two sentences. Shown on the gallery card and as the lead of your project page.
projects.gallery.builtOnPlaceholder: What came from the platform (auth, multi-tenancy, module APIs...) and what did your team build on top?
projects.gallery.videoOk: Your video link works for the gallery.
projects.gallery.videoRequired: The gallery needs a YouTube or Loom link in the Video URL field above. Other hosts (Vimeo, Drive, mp4 files) cannot be embedded.
projects.gallery.screenshotsHelp: Pick 2 or 3 of your uploaded screenshots, describe each one, and choose the poster shown on the gallery card. PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 5 MB each.
projects.gallery.noScreenshots: Upload screenshots in the Media Gallery above first.
projects.gallery.unsupportedImage: This format is not supported by the gallery.
projects.gallery.imageTooLarge: Larger than 5 MB, too big for the gallery.
projects.gallery.showTeamHelp: Off by default. When off, only your team name appears on the public page.
projects.gallery.consent: We have the rights to this content and agree to it being published publicly in the Open Mercato Project Gallery.
projects.gallery.status.prOpen: In review by the gallery team
projects.galleryAdmin.prCloseFailed: Marked as not accepted, but the pull request could not be closed. Close it on GitHub.
projects.galleryAdmin.rejected: Gallery request marked as not accepted
projects.galleryAdmin.title: Open Mercato Project Gallery
projects.galleryAdmin.notOptedIn: The team did not ask for this project to be published in the gallery.
projects.galleryAdmin.optIn: Team opted in to the gallery
projects.galleryAdmin.consentGiven: Publication consent given by the team.
projects.galleryAdmin.consentMissing: The team has not confirmed publication consent. Only the team can give it, from the portal.
projects.galleryAdmin.teamShown: Team member names will be shown.
projects.galleryAdmin.stillDraft: The project has not been submitted yet
projects.galleryAdmin.notConfigured: GALLERY_GITHUB_TOKEN is not set on the server, so pull requests cannot be opened
projects.galleryAdmin.published: Pull request is up on the gallery repository
